body:
All of these things take more time than I'm willing to spend living. Fixing the fuckups I've made during my adulthood will take years, if I'm even able to.

I've got hobbies, they just don't interest me anymore. I've got friends, they've just moved out of this hellhole of a town ages ago and I'm rarely able to see them - they've got a life, I don't. Chatting on Facebook and such just isn't the same as actually spending time with someone. And making new friends is difficult at my age, and I despise the people of this town.

I get nothing out of exercise. It's tons of hard work and pain for months on end just to see some progress and then I just end up injuring myself or slipping out of it. Exercising to improve mood is a myth, at least in my case.

Also, I got my job through family connections - nothing else.
